title: Soft Green Protein Matcha Landing Page

analysis.title: Soft Green Protein Matcha Landing Page
analysis.notes: A pale botanical-green field supports oversized dark-green lettering, compact pill navigation, and a large angled product cup framed by a white arc. Handwritten callouts, stacked benefit badges, and tightly packed headline blocks combine editorial polish with approachable wellness packaging.
analysis.heroPrompt: Create a polished wellness landing-page hero visual on a pale sage-green background: a chilled olive-green matcha protein drink in a tall paper cup with a white lid, angled slightly and cropped near the lower center. Add a bold white circular arc behind the cup, soft studio lighting, subtle condensation, and clean product-render realism. Use dark forest-green geometric accents and generous negative space, with no readable text, logos, brand marks, or people.
